name: Jisri
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Jisri (also known as Jitsri or Isri) is a person mentioned in the biblical genealogies. He was a son of Ulla, a descendant of Asher, and belonged to the tribe of Asher. He is mentioned as a family head and a brave warrior among the descendants of Asher.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Jisri is listed as one of the sons of Ulla in the tribal genealogy of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Described as a brave warrior
keyEvents.description: Jisri and his relatives in the tribe of Asher are described as brave warriors, family heads, and chosen men.

keyEvents.title: Recorded among the fighting forces of Asher
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Asher, including Jisri, were counted among those fit for military service, totaling 26,000 men.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Inheritance of the Tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: As a member of the tribe of Asher, Jisri was part of the tribe that received its inheritance in northern Canaan, originally assigned during the division of the land.
